hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *package-lock.json|*/packages/core/test/vectors/*) echo "Protected by AGENTS.md: $f (lockfile or C2SP vectors). Ask the user first." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); bin="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt"; [ -x "$bin" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in */docs/*|*/test/vectors/*|*/test/fixtures/*|*/.github/badges/*) exit 0 ;; *.ts|*.json|*.md|*.yml) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$bin" "$f" >/dev/null ;; esac
